paragraphs: Rabbi Yonatan ben Elazar: see above, Yonatan ben Akhmai. Chagigah 20a. Yuchasin writes: Rabbi Yochanan ben Elazar, in Rabbah bar bar Chana’s time; he spoke in Rabbi Shimon son of Rabbi Yose ben Lakonya’s name—see his entry—and they are one. Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani transmitted in his name. Yet what he wrote, that Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani spoke in his name, concerns the unqualified Rabbi Yonatan; this requires examination.
